Wave Motion Quirk.name: Wave Motion Quirk
Wave Motion Quirk.description:
🌀 You turn your stamina into visible spiral shockwaves.

🌱 At the start you push one nearby adult back, shove loose debris aside, soften a fall or lift yourself briefly with waves from your hands or feet.
📈 With training: controlled descents, repeated blasts, broad rescue pushes, stronger waves, sustained flight.
⚠️ You spend stamina on every wave; slow spirals give targets time to dodge, hit allies in their path and cannot turn around walls, while flight needs repeated output.
🔗 Canon Drawback, built in: Stamina Drain, as every spiral spends your own energy.
🎬 Canon Quirk: Nejire Hado's Wave Motion. You are not related to her; people who know her Quirk notice the resemblance.

📈 Grants: Endurance +1, Quirk Output +10, Quirk Stamina +10, Evacuation +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Spiral Palm, Heel Wave Lift
Wave Motion Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects:
Scale: own stamina becomes visible twisting shockwaves, mainly from hands and feet. Start: push a nearby person back, shove loose debris or briefly lift themselves. Stronger blasts, accurate flight, broad waves need training.
Limits: each wave costs stamina; long use weakens. Spirals are slow; alert targets dodge. Waves cross open space, hitting what they meet; no curving around walls or sparing allies. Aim and control force near civilians. Sustained flight needs repeated foot output, faltering when exhausted.
Quirk Strain: light: short push or lift; moderate: repeated blasts, controlled descent, brief flight; heavy: broad waves, sustained flight; severe: large release, extended air battle.
Drawback: built in, the canon Stamina Drain.
Canon: Nejire Hado's Quirk; user is unrelated, no tie unless the story makes one; those who know it see the resemblance.
Type: Emitter.
Law: user answers for bystanders hit; choose a clear line of fire.
Look: bright spirals.
